title: kith-tslocal: null byte rejection, response size cap, and cache design are solid
description: LocalApiClient::whois() correctly: (1) rejects null bytes in user_id, login_name, node.name, and display_name with explicit WhoIsFailed errors; (2) caps response body size via http_body_util::Limited before JSON parsing for both WhoIs (100 KiB) and Status (10 MiB); (3) never holds the cache Mutex across an .await; (4) never caches failures. The cache retain() on every write is correct TTL eviction. The timeout wrapping via tokio::time::timeout with a 5-second window is appropriate. Integration tests cover 404, missing socket, null byte in login_name, and oversized body. Test fixtures are hand-constructed from the Tailscale LocalAPI spec, not derived from running the code.
